newsitem.title: GERMANY: Decision on Kolbenschmidt stake due Feb 26.
newsitem.headline: Decision on Kolbenschmidt stake due Feb 26.

text.p: The German cartel office will decide on February 26 whether British auto components group T&N Plc can take a stake in the German piston and bearing firm Kolbenschmidt AG, Germany's Metallbank said on Wednesday.

Metallbank last December took over a 24.99 percent stake in Kolbenschmidt from Commerzbank and passed it onward to a group of institutional investors, retaining the right to recall the stake if required.
Metallbank's managing director Lothar Mark said that T&N had an option to take over the stake in Kolbenschmidt at 17 marks per share.
However, T&N still needs the approval of German competition authorities, which have blocked earlier attempts by T&N to buy Kolbenschmidt on competition grounds.
T&N previously had an option to buy shares in Kolbenschmidt when they were held by Commerzbank. That time, the cartel authority intervened and the option expired.
T&N has sinced renewed its option to buy the stake passed on to Metallbank until September 1997.
Metallbank said that its takeover of the Kolbenschmidt stake in December had a "champagne-cork effect" on Kolbenschmidt shares, which had risen steadily from 16 marks to up to 24 marks.
Kolbenschmidt shares ended bourse trade in Frankfurt on Wednesday at 22.80 marks.
